This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is filed by the insurance company being aggrieved of award dated 03.02.2021 passed by the learned Second Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhopal in MACC No.1577/2018 (Soni Bai and others Vs. Laxman Bhilala and others), on a singular ground that issue No.3, namely, there was violation of the terms and conditions of the policy despite being proved, learned Tribunal lost sight of the fact that after recording a finding of violation of the policy, insurance company should have been exonerated and award should have been directed to be paid by the owner driver of the offending vehicle i.e. pick-up van bearing No. MP69-G-0326.
2.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Soni Bai and others Vs. Laxman Bhilala and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri Ambuj Jain, learned counsel for the respondents No.1 and 3 submits that he has filed an application for disbursement of the claim amount.

However, he does not dispute this finding recorded by the learned Tribunal in relation to issue No.3.
3.

Taking this fact into consideration that once it has come on record that the offending vehicle was a pick-up van and it was not having the necessary permit to drive it at the time of the accident then,
after recording a finding of breach of policy, Tribunal should have directed for payment of compensation in favour of the claimants by the insurance company, reserving a right in favour of the insurance company to recover it from the owner driver of the offending vehicle.
This being the ratio of law laid down by the Supreme Court in Pappu and others Vs. Vinod Kumar Lamba, (2018) 3 SCC 208, impugned award is modified to that extent.

entities.text: Pappu and others Vs. Vinod Kumar Lamba, (2018) 3 SCC 208
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. It is directed that insurance company shall satisfy the award for the claimants and thereafter, will be free to recover it from the owner driver of the offending vehicle.
5. In above terms, this miscellaneous appeal is allowed and disposed of.
6. Record of the learned Claims Tribunal be sent back.
